title: School Pizza from 1988
description: A nostalgic recipe for the iconic rectangular school pizza from 1988, based on the original USDA recipe.

ingredients.item: or 7 grams of active dry yeast
or 3320 grams of all-purpose or bread flour
or 55 grams of instant nonfat dry milk
vegetable oil, plus more for greasing the pan

steps: Dissolve the dry yeast into the warm water and let it sit for five minutes.
Add the flour, dry milk, sugar, and salt to a stand mixer and mix using the whisk attachment on low for four minutes.
Add the frothy yeast mixture and vegetable oil to the dough and continue to mix on medium speed for 10 minutes.
Prepare a half sheet pan by coating it with oil and sprinkling evenly with cornmeal.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and spread it out to cover the base, allowing it to relax and spread.
Let the dough sit for 20 minutes while preheating the oven to 475°F (245°C) or 425°F (218°C) for convection.
Bake the pre-baked crust for 10 minutes (7 minutes for convection).
Prepare the sauce by mixing dried onions, garlic powder, black pepper, tomato paste, water, and seasonings in a saucepan, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Spread 1 1/2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese over the partially baked crust.
Pour the simmered tomato sauce over the cheese, smoothing it out evenly.
Sprinkle the remaining cheese evenly over the top, reaching the edges of the pan.
Bake until the cheese is lightly browned, approximately 11 minutes.
Remove from oven, cut into slices, and serve.
